messages:
mina: Quick bug report: the /v1/embeddings/batch docs show `include_ids: true` in the curl example, but the Go SDK example sends `include_ids: \"true\"` (string). Runtime accepts boolean only, so generated Go snippet is misleading. Also the response examples show `ids: [123,124]` (numbers) whereas runtime returns string IDs for traceability. We should standardize and add a tiny migration note.

oscar: Yikes. That explains customer confusion in the forum. Runtime schema is `include_ids` boolean and `ids` are strings. Looks like we accidentally copied an older Go example that serializes booleans as strings.

rachel: Plan: update examples (curl/python/js/go) to use true/false (no quotes) and change response examples to `ids: [\"123\",\"124\"]`. Add a migration blurb: \"If your client decoded numeric IDs, cast to string to avoid loss of precision.\"

mina: I'll open a docs PR with the corrected request/response examples and a 1-line migration snippet for Go: `for i := range res.Ids { ids[i] = strconv.FormatInt(res.Ids[i], 10) }` and a JS/py one-liner too.

oscar: Also check OpenAPI: the schema currently says `ids: integer[]` in the response. Please change to `string[]` and bump the examples. If we change the OpenAPI we should annotate the change in the changelog so codegens pick it up.

harry: Heads-up from product: switching to string IDs is intended (will help cross-service correlation). We want the docs to reflect runtime truth ASAP. Deprecation not needed since this is a docs/schema correction; but we should call out that existing integrations which parsed numeric IDs must update.

rachel: Devex note: when we change OpenAPI, client generators may start returning strings, but some customers rely on numeric types. Let's add a short client migration note and recommend `Number(id)` where appropriate in JS if they are sure it's numeric. Also mention safety: \"prefer strings to avoid precision loss for large IDs.\"

mina: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9123. Includes fixed examples, OpenAPI snippet suggestion, and migration notes for Go/JS/Python. I also added a harness test that asserts `typeof ids[0] === 'string'` in the preview.

devex-bot: devex-bot: PR 9123 deployed to preview -> https://deploy-preview-9123--docs.redwood.ai. Auto-tests: examples render; harness assertions passing.

oscar: Tiny asks: 1) please include both old and new example responses in the migration note so support can paste them, 2) add a one-liner curl `jq` transform to coerce numeric IDs to strings for callers who can't update code yet.

rachel: Added both examples and this `jq` example: `curl ... | jq '.ids |= map(tostring)'`. Also added a short support blurb.

mina: Updated per feedback. CI shows preview green. Anyone object to merging?

oscar: LGTM from infra/devex pov. harry?

harry: LGTM. Please merge and ping support + release notes channel. We should add a tiny bullet in the next release notes: \"Embeddings batch: ids are strings; update parsing if you previously assumed integers.\"

mina: Merged. I'll follow up with a short slack announcement in #support and add the release-note bullet. Thanks all :sparkles:
